1.  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Sternquist called the City Council Regular Meeting to order at 7: m. in the Council
  00 p.  Chambers
  located at 5938 Kauffman Avenue, Temple City.

2.  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  Councilmember —  Chavez, Chen, Yu, Man, Sternquist

  ABSENT:  Councilmember — None

  ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Cook, City Attorney Murphy, and City Clerk Kuo

3.  INVOCATION - Pastor Kelty, Community of Christ, provided the invocation.

  Captain Meza introduced the Deputy of the Year, Deputy Benjamin  Swartz.

  Mayor Sternquist and City Council congratulated Deputy Swartz and presented him with a plaque and a
  certificate.
